title: Create Outlook email drafts with AI for new conversations
h1: start a new outlook email as a draft
description: Turn a brief into a standalone Outlook draft with a subject, body and optional files. Review recipients yourself and use a different action for replies.
keywords: outlook draft new email with ai
answer: a bot can save a new outlook email with a subject, body, recipients and optional attachments for you to finish later. this action starts a standalone conversation; it does not create a reply inside an existing thread. saving it is a write that needs read and write access, but it does not send the email. ask for a preview if even saving the draft should wait for you.
og_line: a new email, saved for you to finish.
what:
give the bot the purpose of the email and the information it can safely use. subject and body are required; recipients can be left unset while you decide who should receive it. the action can add to, cc and bcc addresses and files.

this is for a fresh email, such as introducing a project to a new contact. to answer an email in its own thread, a different action, create draft reply, is used. dusk bot counts that one as a send, so it follows your sending setting. do not use a new standalone draft when keeping the original conversation is important.
uses: prepare a new introduction from your notes while leaving the recipient for you to choose
save an event invitation email with the venue brief attached for your own review
turn a short project outline into an unsent announcement addressed to an approved list

routine.message: each thursday at 09:50, use the outreach brief i added here this week to propose a new outlook introduction for hazelspoke interiors. show the subject and body here, then wait for my agreement before saving a standalone draft with the recipients left blank. attach only the brochure i explicitly provided and tell me here when the draft is saved. never send it or create a reply to an existing email.
routine.needs: outlook connected with read and write access for create email draft
routine.output:
new outlook draft proposal
subject: introducing hazelspoke interiors
body: a short introduction based on vera’s approved studio brief
recipient: left blank for you
waiting before saving; no email sent.

steps: connect outlook in **Connected apps** and enable **read and write** for new-draft creation.
tell the bot this is a new conversation, give the subject and brief, and decide whether to leave the recipient empty.
ask for one proposed draft in chat before saving. include an explicit checkpoint if you need that review on every run.
open the saved draft in outlook and inspect its addresses and files. **Pause** the outreach routine when the current campaign ends.
watch: this action does not thread a reply to a received message. use the separate draft-reply action when that is the actual task.
html content needs the html flag. otherwise the markup can appear literally in the draft body.
read-only access cannot save a draft. you can limit the bot to this one action so it can't change anything else in outlook.

faq.q: can i save a draft without a recipient?
faq.a: yes. the subject and body are required, but recipient lists are optional. leaving them blank can be useful while the email is still being prepared.

faq.q: does this send the email or reply in the old thread?
faq.a: neither. it saves a new standalone draft. sending or creating a draft reply uses separate actions with their own handling.
